claims: The 2026 NFL Draft will be held from April 23–25, 2026.
The 2026 NFL Draft will be held in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania.
Events of the 2026 NFL Draft will be centered around Acrisure Stadium and Point State Park.
The 2026 NFL Draft is a three-day event.
The first round of the 2026 NFL Draft will be on Thursday.
Rounds 2–3 of the 2026 NFL Draft will be on Friday.
Rounds 4–7 of the 2026 NFL Draft will be on Saturday.
Round 1 of the 2026 NFL Draft starts at 8:00 PM ET on Thursday, April 23.
Rounds 2-3 of the 2026 NFL Draft start at 7:00 PM ET on Friday, April 24.
Rounds 4-7 of the 2026 NFL Draft start at 12:00 PM ET on Saturday, April 25.
All times for the 2026 NFL Draft schedule are Eastern.
The location of the 2026 NFL Draft is Pittsburgh, PA (North Shore and Downtown).
The time between first-round selections in the 2026 NFL Draft has been reduced to eight minutes.
Live coverage of the 2026 NFL Draft is on ESPN, ABC, NFL Network, and NFL+.
Attendance at the 2026 NFL Draft is free for fans.
Registration for the 2026 NFL Draft is available through the NFL OnePass app.
